messages:
incident-bot: PAGER FIRED — service: inference-canary

pagerduty: Trigger: error_rate_5xx > 5% over 2m (route: canary-deploys). PD Incident: INC-9421

maria (oncall): ack — seeing alerts, pulling up Grafana now. tagging @sam for the rollout context

sam (eng-release): thx. last deploy was a canary rollout 10m ago: release/2026-03-14-v2.9.3 to 10% traffic. I swept the changelog: kv-cache tweak + quantization param change. Rolling back if obvious.

jess (sre): svc logs show increased `torch.distributed` errors and OOMs on canary instances. sample from pod inference-canary-3:
```
2026-03-14T14:02:13Z ERROR Runtime: 'CUDA out of memory' at inference.py:412
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/inference.py", line 412, in forward
    alloc = torch.empty((batch, seq, hidden_size), device='cuda')
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```

maria (oncall): concordant with 5xx spike on Grafana. p95 latency up from 120ms to 1.2s. Customer impact: API error rate ~6.5% for canary-routed customers (small subset). Not wide yet.

sam (eng-release): can we confirm it's strictly memory regression? any config drift? alex, did autoscaler config change for canaries?

alex (eng-platform): did not touch autoscaler. I see canary pool got unpacked on smaller GPU type by mistake during release job — one node is `a100-20gb` (tight for our batch size). That would explain OOMs.

jess (sre): agree. replicas 3, but one node is constrained. rolling requests got routed to that node because of scheduling. Recommending immediate rollback of v2.9.3 canary and requeue pods onto uniform nodes.

sam (eng-release): Recommend: 1) scale canary down to 0 2) re-deploy previous canary image (v2.9.2) 3) mark release blocked. I'll start rollback now. Anyone object?

maria (oncall): go ahead. Paging escalations: if rollback fails, escalate to oncall-manager.

sam (eng-release): running:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference-canary inference=redwood/inference:v2.9.2
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-canary
```

sam (eng-release): rollout in progress — pod restarts showing healthy logs. monitoring metrics.

incident-bot: PD INC-9421: acknowledged by maria. Escalation timer paused.

maria (oncall): metrics returning to baseline — error rate down to 0.4% in last 2m. p95 back to ~130ms. Marking as mitigated.

pagerduty: INC-9421 status: resolved by on-call action (rollback) — resolution_note: canary regression due to heterogeneous GPU scheduling causing OOMs; rollback to v2.9.2.

sam (eng-release): filing a follow-up action item: fix release job to pin node selectors for canary pool; add a pre-release check that verifies GPU type homogeneity. I'll open a PR and link here.

alex (eng-platform): will add a transient alert for heterogeneous node types in a pool and a sanity check in deployment pipeline.

jess (sre): postmortem needed — small-impact but real customer errors. I'll start the incident template and assign.

maria (oncall): handoff: @jess will take lead for postmortem, @sam to own rollout fix, @alex to own platform guardrails. I'll drop a short blameless summary to #incidents-announce and notify CS for customers who saw errors.

sam (eng-release): PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/718 — pins canary nodeSelector and adds health-check step.

jess (sre): routing to oncall-manager if any regressions recur. closing thread in 1h if no recurrence. :white_check_mark:

maria (oncall): resolved. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
